entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: The person in a spacesuit on the image-right; the face is visible inside the transparent visor, the forearm has a blue display surface, and part of the backpack extends beyond the top edge of the image.

entities.name: Person B
entities.identification: The person in a spacesuit on the image-left, bending forward close to the equipment box; there is a circular shoulder patch, a white backpack is behind the person, and the gloved hands move near the equipment box.

entities.name: silver-gray gridded metal panel assembly
entities.identification: The assembly located between and behind Person A and Person B, comprising a light-colored horizontal-bar grille on a black background and a silver-gray panel surface with fastening points.

entities.name: planetary background
entities.identification: The partial blue-and-white surface of a planet in the distant view at the top of the image, with white clouds distributed over the blue regions.

entities.name: black-gray angular equipment box
entities.identification: The angular equipment box in the lower-left foreground, with dark side surfaces, a light-gray sloped surface, and light-colored edges; there is a small metal ring near the upper edge.
